# Learning Channel Hygiene

Workspace notes are an operational cache, not a blog.

## Capture timing

Record a pattern the moment it succeeds—end-of-run dumps often starve under pressure.

## One line per pattern

Modify in place when updates arrive; duplication trains contradictory reflexes.

## Verified facts only

Label guesses as hypotheses or omit them—polluted notes masquerade as procedures.

## Conflict resolution

Live measurements defeat stale notes; replace, don’t append debates.
